My Lesson Buddy browser prototype

Transformers.js 3.8.1 — Hugging Face — Apache License 2.0
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
ONNX Runtime Web — Microsoft — MIT License
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
fflate 0.8.3 — 101arrowz — MIT License
https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

The optional model is HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct, revision
7e3e67edbbed1bf9888184d9df282b700a323964, Apache License 2.0.
Model weights are downloaded from Hugging Face by the visitor, not bundled here.
https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct

Character parts and lesson illustrations are original project artwork.
Narration assets were generated locally for this project; no paid speech API is used.

Neural narration uses Kokoro-82M v1.0 — hexgrad — Apache License 2.0.
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
Model-card training-data attributions:
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M#creative-commons-attribution
Build-time ONNX adapter: kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 — thewh1teagle — MIT License.
https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx
The pretrained voice af_heart is used; no person's voice is cloned or uploaded.
Model weights and inference dependencies are not distributed with the website.
